fields.quote: You can choose to subscribe to a paid plan at the end of the trial period if you'd like to.

notes: The pricing page renders both toggle states: the first block (yearly, '~25% savings') shows Start $37, Scale $97, Pro $197, Max $697 per month; the second block (monthly) shows Start $47, Scale $127, Pro $247, Max $897 per month. No yearly total is displayed. Each plan also carries a transaction fee (2% on Start, 1% on Scale and Pro, none on Max) and a contact cap (1,000 / 10,000 / 25,000 / 100,000 contacts). The 'old stack' calculator ($49, $50/user, $25, $29, $49; total $153/mo, $1,836/yr) prices competitor tools, not Outseta plans. 14-day free trial on every plan ('Sign up for free' starts the trial), 30-day money-back guarantee; no free plan, hence pricing_status paid (product owner to confirm). WordPress and React appear only as names in the home-page integrations grid under 'Integrate with nearly any tool or framework under the sun.'; Carrd and Weweb are also listed there. Customer stats ('46 Countries with Outseta customers', '9+ Years powering creator businesses') and customer stories are company-stated, not payment proof; '9+ years' must not be turned into a launch_year or founded_year (forbidden). The company page shows six team members but states no headcount, and states no country or city (team 'fully remote'), so these fields are forbidden. Footer 'Partner program' link and 'Stripe verified partner' badge are incidental: the core product is an all-in-one membership/SaaS operations stack (payments, auth, CRM, email, help desk), eligible.
